built by 14_build_utoronto_tfs from vendored sources/DatabaseExtract_v_1.01.txt (Human TFs v1.01, Lambert et al. 2018); Is.TF.=="Yes" mapped through HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE to prot-ph features - 1381 sites x 383 TF genes, columns feature_id+gene_symbol. Upstream joins on `platform`, which HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE does not have (it has `assay`), so the upstream generator cannot rebuild its own object and the SHIPPED .rda is the raw 2765x28 download instead. That shape has no feature_id, and subset_qc() skips a NULL desired_features, so subset_TFs=TRUE in .load_scion_matrixes() is a SILENT NO-OP against the released object - SCION gets every phosphosite, not the TF pool. This build is what makes subset_TFs work.

built by 15_build_ptmsea_input; prot-ph DA z-scores as a PTM-SEA input .gct (muscle 16469x6, adipose 7287x2). shipped by the Analysis package from v2.0 (upstream shipped preprocess_PTMSEA() as a function, not an object); it holds no sample-level data - cdesc is empty and every column is a contrast, so it routes analysis-side like any other computed result. The PTM-SEA run itself is out of scope: the .gct is handed to the Broad Institute PTM-SEA/ssGSEA2.0 Docker image, which this repo does not pull, run, or make any reproducibility claim over.
